prep.summary: Review your recent alignments with Adam and Jon—which expose a fragmented 'Hydra' operating model requiring seven to eight handoff steps and a highly anxious team transitioning data design to a new five-person group. Present these critical capacity constraints to Chris to justify his immediate deployment as a stabilizing architectural lead—then pivot to a personal check-in to assess his overall well-being and readiness.
tasks: Ask Chris how he is doing personally to establish alignment and gauge his overall morale.
Detail the capacity constraints of the 'Hydra' operating model and its seven-to-eight handoff steps.
Explain the transition of data design responsibilities to the new five-person team and the resulting anxieties.
Propose Chris's involvement in structuring the operating model between architecture and Dan's business partners.

prep.summary: You must align your technical roadmap with RV's platform capability-based mapping—shifting away from traditional domain roadmaps—while preparing for the upcoming August 4th architect headcount reduction. Stop forcing the usage of Jira Work Management and OurDoc for personal tasks—a core element of the team's start/stop/continue feedback—and pivot toward fit-for-purpose tooling. Establish Architecture as an authoritative tollgate in technology decisions—specifically reinforcing the permit-to-design, build, and operate models discussed with Arden—to enforce non-functional requirements and prevent wasteful vendor research.
tasks: Finalize the stack-ranked architect list with HR and Joe Monk ahead of the August 4th restructuring impact date.
Transition the architecture strategy toward capability-based mapping to align directly with RV’s platform strategy.
Draft the formal measurement criteria for grading applications against non-functional requirement benchmarks.
Terminate the mandatory usage of Jira Work Management and OurDoc for personal task tracking.
Pause premature vendor research on Sokocha integrations and virtual power plant image analysis to prevent waste.
